description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 4.
